steps.label: Ordered what moved first, 55–64 s
steps.summary: first to move: actuator.output[ch[3]] at 60.369 s, vehicle.attitude[pitch] at 60.433 s, actuator.output[ch[1]] at 60.617 s

result.headline: Pitch-loop output ch3 froze at 1100 us at 60.4 s; attitude tracking degraded from 58.3 s
result.explanation: A control fault occurred near 58-60 s on the pitch-loop actuator channel ch[3], which went to 1100 us and stayed there. The data cannot show whether the servo, the output stage or the controller caused it.

evidence.quote: CONSTANT actuator.output[ch[3]] was varying, then held 1100 from t=60.369 s to the end of the recording (8.814 s, 28 samples)
evidence.shows: ch3 output froze at 1100 us with no mode change or event to explain it

evidence.quote: ROLE actuator.output[ch[3]] follows control.attitude_setpoint[pitch] (correlation -0.819 over the recording): it serves that loop
evidence.shows: The frozen channel serves the pitch loop

evidence.quote: ANOMALY a3 t=58.306 s: vehicle.attitude[pitch] did not follow control.attitude_setpoint[pitch] (peak |error| 10.958) (see line 84; strength 2.847)
evidence.shows: Pitch tracking began failing at 58.3 s, before the freeze at 60.4 s

evidence.quote: ANOMALY a4 t=59.284 s: vehicle.attitude[roll] followed control.attitude_setpoint[roll] worse for good (typical |error| 0.907 -> 14.506) (see line 88; strength 4.135)
evidence.shows: Roll tracking also degraded for good, from 59.3 s

evidence.quote: SHIFT propulsion.throttle changed level for good at t=61.431 s: median 55 before, 75 after % (6.7x its variation before)
evidence.shows: Throttle, ch1, ch2, ch4 and ch5 moved afterwards, consistent with the controller compensating

checked.check: Which signal left its baseline first in 55-64 s
checked.result: ch3 left baseline first at 60.369 (1500 -> 1100 us). Pitch attitude followed at 60.433, then ch1, ch4 and ch5 at 60.617.
checked.about: Actuator output ch3 as the earliest visible sign

checked.check: compare at 60.369: what changed after the freeze
checked.result: ch3 frozen. Roll tracking error went 1.592 -> 18.427 deg, pitch 1.409 -> 7.419. Other outputs and throttle shifted.
checked.about: Actuator output ch3 as the onset of the control fault

checked.check: compare at 58.306: earlier pitch tracking onset
checked.result: Pitch error went 1.312 -> 7.024 and roll error 0.478 -> 16.799 over the window. The 4 s after-window includes the ch3 freeze, so it does not separate onset from the freeze.
checked.about: Whether a degradation preceded the ch3 freeze

checked.result: Only two events, both at 0.654 s (Battery low voltage warning, Sensor health error). No earlier cases match.

effects.quote: SHIFT actuator.output[ch[4]] changed level for good at t=60.901 s: median 1500 before, 1587 after us (14.5x its variation before)
effects.why: Other pitch-loop outputs moved after ch3 froze, consistent with the controller compensating

effects.quote: SHIFT propulsion.throttle changed level for good at t=61.431 s: median 55 before, 75 after % (6.7x its variation before)
effects.why: The throttle rise and altitude loss follow the loss of control

effects.quote: ANOMALY a10 t=61.309 s: vehicle.attitude[yaw] followed control.attitude_setpoint[yaw] worse for good (typical |error| 94.411 -> 174.175) (see line 94; strength 3.877)
effects.why: The yaw error was already about 94 deg before the fault, so this is a downstream or secondary effect

next_action.action: Inspect ch3 servo, linkage and wiring; read the flight controller's raw ch3 command
next_action.why: Separates a controller that stopped commanding ch3 from a servo or output-stage fault, since the recording only shows the output value.
how: Bench-test ch3 with the servo powered and the aircraft safe, commanding sweeps from 1100 to 1900 us
Check the servo, connector and linkage for damage or binding
Pull the controller's onboard log for the commanded ch3 value and any failsafe or saturation flags from 58-61 s
next_action.conditions: Bench with the aircraft restrained and propeller removed; battery fully charged, so the low-voltage warning does not confound.
next_action.baseline: ch3 behaviour before 58 s in this recording, where it followed the pitch setpoint (correlation -0.819 over the recording)

outcomes.label: Servo moves normally on bench
outcomes.means: The fault is in the controller or command path, or load-dependent. The recording only shows the output value.
outcomes.then: Request the controller's commanded ch3 and failsafe flags

outcomes.label: Servo jammed, damaged or dead
outcomes.means: A physical ch3 actuator or linkage fault is the likely cause.
outcomes.then: Inspect for the cause of the damage

outcomes.label: Servo moves, but the supply sags under load
outcomes.means: A power-path problem is the trigger, consistent with the early battery warning.
outcomes.then: Request battery voltage and current during the flight

data_requests.what: Controller onboard log with commanded servo values, failsafe flags and supply voltage
data_requests.why_needed: Separates a controller or command fault from a servo or power fault on ch3

unobservable.fact: Physical state of the ch3 servo, linkage and connector

hypotheses.claim: The ch3 servo, linkage or output stage failed or jammed, leaving the output stuck at 1100 us.
hypotheses.because: ch3 is the first signal to leave baseline and then stays constant, while other pitch-loop outputs compensate afterwards.
hypotheses.observed_at: controller output record, not the physical servo

hypotheses.claim: The controller or mixer pinned or stopped updating the ch3 command.
hypotheses.because: The recording shows the output but not why it was held. No mode change or event is recorded.

hypotheses.claim: A low battery or servo supply trigger affected the output stage. The start-up low-voltage warning is the only hint.
hypotheses.because: A Low voltage warning appears at 0.654 s, but it is a start-up line with no later change pointing back to it.

hypotheses.claim: A sensor or estimate fault caused the tracking error that preceded the freeze.
hypotheses.because: The sensor-health error is a start-up line. Pitch tracking diverged from 58.3 s, but the attitude responded to the ch3 freeze.

events.why: Appear at 0.654 s in the start-up window and nothing later points back to them.

events.what: Pitch and roll tracking degrade from 58.3 s and 59.3 s
events.why: Error grows for good, before the ch3 freeze at 60.369 s.

events.what: ch3 output frozen at 1100 us from 60.369 s
events.why: Pitch-loop output stops following its setpoint and holds one value, with no mode change.

events.what: ch1, ch2, ch4, ch5 and throttle shift after the freeze
events.why: The controller compensating for the lost ch3.
